full_name: Leigh A. Payne | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Lisa Goldberg Fellow University of Oxford (United Kingdom)
bio: Leigh A. Payne is a professor of sociology and Latin America at the University of Oxford’s St Antony’s College. At Radcliffe, she will use a performative analysis to examine armed actors’ confessions to rape committed during Colombia’s 50 years of conflict.
